result.title: Robust and Efficient Continual Model Merging via Global Singular Subspace Separation and Restoration
result.summary: Continual model merging incrementally integrates task-specific models without revisiting past models or data. However, repeated merging entangles past task components and distorts their singular geometry, making balanced task-wise allocation increasingly difficult. We propose Global Singular Subspace Separation and Restoration (GS3R), which augments the merged update with a compact restoration state. At each merge, GS3R restores the retained singular geometry, separates task-wise subspaces, and globally reallocates the available rank across tasks fairly. To reduce merging-time memory overhead, we further introduce Pre-merge Restoration and Flushing (PRF). Experiments on vision, NLP, and multimodal benchmarks show that GS3R provides a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

AI.brief_summary: 针对持续模型合并中重复合并使旧任务分量纠缠、奇异几何被扭曲的问题，提出 GS3R：用紧凑的 restoration state 恢复保留的奇异几何、分离任务子空间并全局重分配可用秩，并引入 Pre-merge Restoration and Flushing 降低合并时显存开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 其基于 SVD 的子空间分离与跨任务秩再分配，可能为 latent 状态中任务相关子空间的隔离、抑制多次更新导致的信息坍缩提供可核查线索；但论文本身不涉及 VLM 推理，联系仅属方法层面的推测。
